question:
Which of the following terms will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

XFCJ, ADFH, ?, GZLD, JXOB
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a835466a0ca329b315515a2c520bc9299c828e660166f97e8bf6be6cf2f1ce31.png] 

**Given:**

XFCJ, ADFH, ?, GZLD, JXOB

**Logic:** 'Addition of (3) in the position value of the first and third alphabet and subtraction of (2) from the position value of the second and fourth alphabet'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c18004ae32b1db6b3bee0a5b543ac1e8fbb9017f227695daa378964be2baf49.png] 

Here,** 'DBIF' **is the missing term.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
